card.title: Find the Real Authority
card.instruction: Probe until you know who can approve, block, or reverse the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I book the trip, who can still cancel it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The committee approved it. Please book before we lose the coach.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whose objection would stop you paying the deposit?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The treasurer's. But she's away, and her deputy has the bank login.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can the deputy release it alone, or does she still need the treasurer's permission?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can the deputy release it alone, or does she still need the treasurer's permission?

mechanism: A probes beyond committee assent to identify who can actually release or block the trip deposit.
confusable: Unlike general planning questions, A must distinguish formal approval from practical veto and delegated control.
comparison: D54-a tests whether login access includes authority; D54-b tests whether a caretaker reversal came from power or access to a person.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
